fields.Name: T278 - Home Pin a Resource Round-Trip
fields.Description: Exercises PinAppNavItem()/PinFromPanel() → HomeAppPinService.AddPin() persistence and the live update of both the panel's pinned state and the PinnedItems grid — a real create round-trip, distinct from the read-only section-render tests.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Go to the Home landing page (Home icon/logo or application switcher dropdown). In the 'Pinned' section click 'Add Pin' to open the slide-in panel and wait for it to load. Expand the 'Applications' section and click the 'Pin' button on any application nav item. Verify the app responds: a success toast like '"..." pinned to Home' appears AND the item's button flips to a 'Pinned' badge (check mark). Close the panel and confirm the newly pinned item now appears as a card in the 'Pinned' grid on the Home page. Success is the pin being created and reflected both in the panel badge and the Pinned grid. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Pin' on a catalog item produces a success confirmation (toast) and the item shows a 'Pinned' badge in the panel
After closing the panel, the pinned item is visible as a card in the Home 'Pinned' section
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
